Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! Ireland players are out there in the middle. Kushal Bhurtel and Aasif Sheikh are the openers for Nepal. Mark Adair to start with the ball for Ireland. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Right then! Nepal need 128 runs to win and if they do it quickly they have a big chance to win the whole thing. Can Ireland manage to defend a mediocre total? We'll find out soon. Stay tuned for the chase.

Ireland will be disappointed with that batting performance. They had a chance to leap frog UAE and lift the cup but now they will find it difficult just to restrict their opponents. All the big guns flopped and it was Dockrell who managed to provide some impetus to the Irish innings. They will now have to bowl out of their skins to manage a win here.

Nepal with another stellar performance and they are making a name for themselves. What a brilliant bowling performance it has been to restrict a team like Ireland. Dipendra Singh Airee has done it with the bat so far and now he has shown his class with the ball as well. 4 wickets and he will be all pumped up to do it with the bat as well. Other bowlers supported him very well and Nepal will believe they can win this and have a shot at winning the series as well.

OUT! RUN OUT! Ireland have been bowled out here! Almost a yorker again on middle. Adair hits it to long on and the batters try to steal the second run. However, Dipendra Singh Airee is quick to collect the ball at long on and fires in a throw at the right end where Adair was running back. The keeper, Aasif Sheikh collects the ball and whips the bails off. Adair is short of his crease and Ireland have been bundled out for 127 after 20 overs.
Commentary.Howout: run out (Dipendra Singh Airee / Aasif Sheikh)

Commentary.Commentary: Another single! A fullish delivery on off again. Barry McCarthy drills it to long off for a single.
A yorker outside off. Adair digs it out to deep point for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Andy McBrine holds out here. A fuller delivery on off. Andy McBrine looks to go under it and tries to tonk it over long on. However, he fails to get the enough distance and ends up hitting it to long on. The fielder there Dipendra Singh Airee takes a good catch and Andy McBrine walks back.
Commentary.Howout: c Dipendra Singh Airee b Abinash Bohara

Commentary.Commentary: Another brilliant ball, yorker outside off. Adair manages to hit it to sweeper cover for a single.
A very full ball, on middle. Andy McBrine heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A dot ball this time. Adair just manages to hit it towards covers.
A fuller delivery on off. Andy McBrine drives it to long off now.
SIX! BANG! This is full on off. Andy McBrine gets under it and tonks it over long off for a biggie.

Ohh..brilliant display of sportsmanship from Aasif Sheikh, the keeper! A fuller delivery on off. Adair works it towards the leg side. The batters look for a single and Singh runs towards the ball. There is a collision between Andy McBrine and the bowler. Kamal Singh throws the ball back to the keeper. However, Aasif Sheikh doesn't whips the bails off even though Andy McBrine is outside of his crease. The batter, Andy McBrine and keeper Aasif Sheikh shake hands and that is a beautiful piece of how cricket should be played. Superb stuff by the keeper.
A yorker this time outside off. Adair looks to dig it out but misses.
A fuller delivery on off. Andy McBrine skips down the track and hits it to long off for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Adair pushes it towards the off side.
Tossed up on middle now. Andy McBrine sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Fuller on off. Adair drives it to covers and takes a single.
Flatter and quicker on middle. Adair blocks it out.
A flatter delivery on off. Andy McBrine pushes it towards the off side and takes a quick single.
Andy McBrine is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! That's 50th T20I wicket for Sandeep Lamichhane! This one is tossed up outside off. George Dockrell makes room and looks to go over the top towards covers. He, however, gets an outside edge. The ball goes in the air towards deep point and the fielder there Kushal Bhurtel takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Kushal Bhurtel b Sandeep Lamichhane

Commentary.Commentary: Sandeep Lamichhane is back on.
On middle, Dockrell drives it down to long on for a run.
A length ball, wide of off. This is slashed towards sweeper cover for a run.
Full again, on off. This is bunted out towards silly mid on for a run.
Very full, on off. Adair thumps it down to long off for a single.
On middlle, this is turned through mid on for one.
SIX! Perfectly timed! On off, George Dockrell makes room leg side and goes over extra cover once again. He times it so well that the ball goes all the way for a maximum.
Mark Adair walks out now.

OUT! TAKEN! What a wonderful catch by Dipendra Singh Airee! Tossed up, on middle. Lorcan Tucker dances down the track and just looks to work it past the bowler. The ball goes uppishly to the right of Airee and he puts in a brilliant dive to pouch the catch. Tucker has to depart and Nepal keep on piling the misery.
Flatter, on off. This is cutaway to deep point for a run.
FOUR! Tossed up, on middle. George Dockrell makes room leg side and goes inside-out over extra cover for a lovely boundary.
On off, worked to covers for one more.
Short, on leg. This is pulled down to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Slower through the air, pushed wider. Dockrell shuffles across and turns it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Dipendra Singh Airee will continue. He will finish his spell.
Full and wide, squeezed out to point.
FOUR! Full and straight, Lorcan Tucker drills it straight back past the bowler for a boundary.
On middle, this is turned to mid-wicket for one.
A fullish ball, on middle. Lorcan Tucker thumps it down towards long on for a couple. The fielder over there misfields and they come back for three. Excellent running.
This is angled into the pads. Tucker looks to work it leg side but closes the face of the bat early and gets a leading edge towards shorty cover.
Bohara nails the yorker on middle. Dockrell does well to jam it out towards long on for one.
Good running. On off, Dockrell backs away and taps it to point for a quick run.
Quicker, on off. This is pushed towards cover.
Cheeky! Fuller one, on off. Lorcan Tucker gets inside the line of the ball and plays the reverse paddle past short third man. The batters come back for three with ease.
Shorter delivery, on off. Dockrell cuts it to point for a single.
On middle, this is pushed towards mid on.
Slowed up, on off. Dockrell makes room and works it towards cover-point.
Flatter again, close to the off pole. Dockrell nudges it towards backward point for a run.
On off. This is driven towards mid off.
FOUR! Cutaway and cutaway fine. Flatter delivery, around off. George Dockrell hangs deep and cuts it behind point for a welcome boundary.
Quicker one, on middle. Tucker works it towards mid-wicket for one.
A tad bit short, around off. Dockrell taps it towards cover-point for a quick single.
On off, this is pushed towards covers.
A flatter and quicker delivery on off. Tucker pushes it to covers.
A fuller delivery on middle. George Dockrell knocks it down to long on for a single.

OUT! STUMPED! Another one bites the dust! This is strange shot selection by Simi Singh just like his teammate earlier in the over. A tossed up delivery around off. Singh skips down the track and looks to work it towards the leg side but the ball turns away and completly beats him. The keeper Aasif Sheikh collects the ball and whips the bails off in the flash. Nepal are all over Ireland now. George Dockrell is the next man in.
Commentary.Howout: st Aasif Sheikh b Dipendra Singh Airee

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and flatter outside off. Tucker cuts it to deep cover for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Singh drives it to long off for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Campher departs now and Ireland are in all sorts of trouble. A tossed up delivery on off. Campher gets across and looks to paddle-scoop it. There is no pace on the ball and the ball just loops up in the air towards short fine leg. The fielder there Sharad Vesawkar  takes an easy catch and Curtis Campher has to walk after playing a horrible shot. Simi Singh is the next man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Sharad Vesawkar b Dipendra Singh Airee

Commentary.Commentary: A single to end the over! A fuller delivery on off. Campher drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Pushed quicker on middle. Tucker pushes it to mid on for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Tucker blocks it out.
A fuller delivery on off. Campher drives it to mid off for a single.
Another dot ball! A slightly shorter delivery again. Campher cuts it to covers this time.
A quicker delivery outside off. Campher looks to cut but mistimes it towards the off side.
A quicker delivery on off. Tucker blocks this out off the front foot.
Darted on middle and leg this time. Campher works it to square leg for a single.
Slightly shorter outside off. Tucker cuts it to point for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Campher pushes it to mid off for a single.
Lorcan Tucker is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shane Getkate perishes now! Dipendra Singh Airee with a wicket now. A tossed up delivery on off. Shane Getkate dances down the track and looks to go big downtown. He miscues it and fails to get the distance. The ball goes straight into the hands of Mukhiya at long on and Shane Getkate has to depart.
Commentary.Howout: c Jitendra Mukhiya b Dipendra Singh Airee

Commentary.Commentary: Pushed quicker on off. Campher drives it to mid off for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Campher drives it to covers for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Campher drives it to deep extra cover for a couple.
SIX! This time a biggie from Curtis Campher! Tossed up on middle again and Curtis Campher connects the slog-sweep this time. He hits this way over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Flatter and shorter outside off. Shane Getkate cuts it to covers for a single.
In the air...but safe! Tossed up on middle. Campher goes for a slog-sweep but gets a huge top edge. The ball goes in the air but fall short of the forward running long on  fielder for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Shane Getkate heaves it across the line but gets it off the inside half of his blade to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up on off. Shane Getkate drives it to covers for a single.
Malla drifts on the pads this time. Shane Getkate sweeps it to fine leg for a couple.
Flatter and quicker on middle. Shane Getkate blocks it out.
FOUR! A welcome boundary this for Ireland! Tossed up on middle. Shane Getkate skips down the track and hammers it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Quicker on off. Shane Getkate blocks it out.
Malla starts with a fuller delivery on middle. Campher works it to square leg for a single.
Dot ball to end the over! A tossed up delivery on off. Shane Getkate comes forward and blocks it.
Quicker and flatter on middle. Campher pushes it to mid on for a single.
Slower in the air, outside off. Shane Getkate pushes it towards point for a single.
Flatter anf shorter on off. Campher goes back and pushes it to mid off for a single.
On middle and fuller. Shane Getkate works it to square leg for a single.
A tossed up deliveryb on off. Shane Getkate drives it back to the bowler.
Sandeep Lamichhane is into the attack now.
Another dot ball to end the over! Ireland are 35/3 after Powerplay. A length delivery, outside off. Campher pushes it towards point.
A fuller delivery on off. Campher drives it to covers now.
Back of a length, around off. Shane Getkate pushes it towards point for a single now.
On a length, on middle. Shane Getkate works it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
On a length , on middle. Shane Getkate defends it towards the leg side this time.
A fuller delivery on off. Campher drives it to covers for a single.
A length ball, on off. Shane Getkate drives it to mid off.

OUT! BOWLED! The skipper, Andy Balbirnie departs now. Three down inside the Powerplay. A length ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie looks to pull it but the ball takes the inside edge of his blade and shatters the stumps. A big wicket and Ireland sink further. Shane Getkate is the next man in.
Slightly shorter in length, on off. Andy Balbirnie pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
On a length, on off. Pushed towards the off side for a single.
A fuller ball, on off. Campher drives it to mid on.
A full ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie drives it to covers for a single.
Curtis Campher is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Gareth Delany is gone this time. This is another big blow for Ireland. Nepal are chipping in with wickets quite early in this game. A length delivery on off. Delany drives it hard but straight to the bowler and Jitendra Mukhiya takes a brilliant catch off his own bowling. Nepal are right on top here.

On a length, around off. Andy Balbirnie pushes it to point and sets off for a quick single. There is a shy at the batter's end but misses. A single taken. Direct-hit and Delany was gone for all money.
FOUR! Boundaries are flowing now for Ireland! A length ball, on middle. Andy Balbirnie makes room and slams it through covers for a boundary.
A length ball, around off. Delany steers it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Great use of feet by Gareth Delany! A length ball, outside off. Gareth Delany dances down the track and smashes it through cover-point for a boundary.
A length ball, on off. Delany drives it to covers this time. Dot ball.
Another full toss and Andy Balbirnie misses out again. He looks to drive this but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
A knuckle ball this time but it's a low full toss outside off. Andy Balbirnie swings across the line but misses.
A fuller delivery,outside off. Delany drives it to mid off and gets a single this time.
Singh goes fuller this time on middle. Andy Balbirnie drives it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Another boundary! A length delivery on off. Andy Balbirnie makes room and lifts this over mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! Andy Balbirnie gets his first boundary now. The bowler drifts on the pads this time. Andy Balbirnie flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another good over for Nepal! A length delivery on off. Gareth Delany pushes it to covers this time.
A length ball, on middle. Andy Balbirnie flicks it easily towards deep square leg for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Gareth Delany steers it to third man for a single.
Jitendra Mukhiya goes fuller on middle this time. Gareth Delany drives it to mid on.
On a length, outside off. Andy Balbirnie cuts it to point for a single now.
A length ball, on middle. Gareth Delany works it past square leg for a single.
Jitendra Mukhiya will start from the other end.
Dot ball to end the over! A fuller delivery on middle. Andy Balbirnie blocks it out comfortably.
Gareth Delany is the next man in.
A length ball, on middle. Delany works it to square leg for a single.

OUT! BOWLED! Paul Stirling departs early yet again! A brilliant yorker on off. Paul Stirling is late to put his bat down in time and the ball shatters the off pole. This is quite a delivery to ball in the first over of the game. A perfect start for Nepal, they have got the big wicket.
A length ball, on off. Paul Stirling blocks it off this time.
Another fuller delivery on middle. Paul Stirling flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
A full delivery on middle Paul Stirling drives it to mid on.
We are ready for play! Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie are the Irish openers. Kamal Singh to open the bowling for Nepal. Let's play...

Andrew Balbrine, the skipper of Ireland, says that would have batted first and they have played good cricket when they bat first. He says that it is a chance to redeem themselves and play better cricket today. He says they have couple of changes.

Sandeep Lamichhane, the skipper of Nepal  says that they will have a bowl first because the weather looks a bit grainy and it will be better to chase. He adds that 14th February holds a special place in Nepal cricket as they won a match from out of nowhere against Namibia. He also informs that there are three changes to the side today.
Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Andy Balbirnie (C), Curtis Campher, Gareth Delany, Lorcan Tucker (WK), George Dockrell, Simi Singh, Shane Getkate, Mark Adair, Andy McBrine, Barry McCarthy.

Nepal (Playing XI) - Kushal Bhurtel, Sharad Vesawkar, Gyanendra Malla, Dipendra Singh Airee (WK), Kushal Malla, Lokesh Bam, Aasif Sheikh, Sandeep Lamichhane (C), Abinash Bohara, Jitendra Mukhiya, Kamal Singh.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Nepal. They have elected to FIELD first.

UPDATE - Alright folks! There is some good news that makes this game more interesting. Oman have beaten United Arab Emirates in the fifth match of the competition and now both Ireland and Nepal have a real chance to clinch this series. However, United Arab Emirates are still at the top of the table with superior run-rate but a convincing victory for the either team in this game can see them move to the top of the table and clinch this series.

Nepal have been a surprise package in this series and have performed exceedingly well. And, if they have a bit of luck on their side, they might just cause an upset here and even have a shot at winning the series. Dipendra Singh Airee has been prolific with the bat and he will look to continue the rich vein of form he's in. So, will either side get a little bit of help from Oman? And if they do, then who will be able to snatch the series? We'll find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.

Ireland would have come into the tournament on the back of a spirited performance against the Windies a month or so earlier and would have looked to win this series comfortably. This hasn't been the case because after a stellar display against the hosts, Ireland came up against an UAE side which was unstoppable and now even if they win against Nepal, their fate isn't in their own hands. Ireland will look to win this match nevertheless.

Hello and a warm welcome to the sixth and final match of the Oman Quadrangular series. The final match is between Ireland and Nepal and both sides are desperate for a win in order to snatch the title if UAE slip up against Oman.
... MATCH DAY …
